name: Event Gateway
description: Expose TikTools domain events to local WebSocket and NDJSON widgets.
longDescription: Starts a loopback-only event gateway at `127.0.0.1:17452`. The gateway owns browser origin validation, CORS, authentication, WebSocket clients, and the HTTP NDJSON fallback.

token.title: Access token
token.description: Generated on first start. Use it in the WebSocket auth message or an HTTP Bearer token.

widgetsDir.title: Widget assets directory
widgetsDir.description: Optional override for the /widgets/ static asset root. Defaults to widgets/ or dist/widgets/ beside the gateway executable.
